description: Reconcile a waivers file against lint output: suppress sanctioned violations and surface the expired, stale, and expiring ones. Returns the effective failing set a build should gate on.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

violations.description: Lint output to reconcile against the waivers. An array of findings, or the object a linter returned.

waivers.description: The waivers file to reconcile — sanctioned violations, with expiry.

name: reconcile_waivers
